scope: G17 Deep Defense Kernel — claim traceability matrix
note: Every major claim: status / supporting gate / source artifact / metric / scope / confidence / safe line / forbidden overclaim. No new metrics; numbers from prior gates.

claims.claim: ALS f64 is the strongest standalone warm collaborative generator
claims.safe_interview_line: ALS f64 is my tuned warm floor, best single generator.

claims.claim: Content-hybrid provides cold-start candidate recall where ALS is 0
claims.metric: cold R@20 0.241; all 1,420 cold items surfaced (catalog candidate coverage)
claims.safe_interview_line: non-zero cold recall where CF is structurally zero.

claims.claim: Co-occurrence adds marginal candidate coverage + directional LTR lift
claims.metric: +3.76pp marginal coverage; LTR R@20 +0.0177 (~1.5 SE), 70% overlap
claims.safe_interview_line: low-cost complementary source; directional, not statistically established.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: significantly improved recall / graph retrieval proven

claims.claim: SASRec-small is the best sequence model but below ALS
claims.safe_interview_line: best sequence model, still below the MF floor.

claims.claim: Full-softmax is the sequence-model lever (6.7x) but does not close gap to ALS
claims.safe_interview_line: the loss mattered (6.7x), still didn't beat MF.

claims.claim: GRU4Rec recurrent baseline ~= SASRec range, below ALS
claims.safe_interview_line: recurrent baseline, same range as SASRec, below MF.

claims.claim: TwoTower neural retrieval is an honest negative
claims.safe_interview_line: I built a neural two-tower baseline; honest negative on this data.

claims.claim: LambdaMART LTR materially beats single-retriever ranking within candidates
GPU sequence features are non-additive to the LTR ranker
claims.metric: +0.0027 R@20 (within noise); importance high but marginal ~0
claims.safe_interview_line: importance is not marginal contribution; GPU features were substitutable.

claims.claim: Candidate coverage is the binding lever; widening converts to higher R@20
claims.safe_interview_line: end-to-end recall was retrieval-bound; widening converted; I adopted the knee.

claims.claim: Aggressive post-hoc slate governance not worth relevance cost; pure LTR default
claims.metric: creator cap Gini 0.864->0.847 at -9.1%; combined 20.7% self-violation; pure LTR already cold 0.282
claims.safe_interview_line: pure LTR default; governance best handled upstream, not post-hoc slate.

claims.claim: FAISS IndexFlatIP exact adopted as ALS-slice serving index (lossless latency win)
claims.safe_interview_line: exact FAISS, identical results, ~39% lower p95.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: FAISS improved recommendation quality / production benchmark

claims.claim: FAISS IVF approximation is a scale-demo, not a current-size win
claims.safe_interview_line: IVF is a scale-demonstration; exact is already sub-ms at 40k items.

claims.claim: OPE estimators validated; logger positivity is decisive
claims.metric: ESS 1.4k->7.6k by logger; DR cannot separate 90/10 from ALS
claims.safe_interview_line: OPE validated estimators; positivity is the deciding factor.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: OPE proved lift / proved a winner

claims.claim: Position-bias correction: naive CTR under-credits cold lane ~11x
claims.metric: cold lane naive 0.0011 vs true 0.0126 (~11x); IPS recovers ~77%
claims.safe_interview_line: raw CTR would have killed the right lane; position correction fixes it.

claims.claim: Prevalence-correct OPE: 90/10 not offline-separable from control
Catalog health: 90/10 improves reach, not de-concentration; reranking can't fix in budget
claims.metric: +26% creators, +444 new, Gini flat-to-worse; reranking de-concentrates only at -18% to -36% recall
claims.safe_interview_line: reach improved, not de-concentration; fairness needs a training-time fix.
deferred to a GPU gate; not silently skipped.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: graph model evaluated / rejected on merit

claims.claim: Claim-safety framework: offline / synthetic / within-candidate / production-shaped
claims.safe_interview_line: offline, evidence-backed, scope-tagged; nothing presented as proven lift or deployed.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: online lift / production / cold-start-solved / fairness-solved / gold-complete
